basic_details.short_information: The Small Industries Development Bank of India (SIDBI) has released the SIDBI Recruitment 2026 notification for 68 Officer vacancies under Grade A and Grade B in General and Specialist Streams. The recruitment includes 63 Assistant Manager Grade A posts and 5 Manager Grade B posts across General, Hindi, Legal and Systems/Information Technology (IT) streams. Eligible candidates can apply online from 21 November 2026 through the official website, sidbi.in. The last date for submitting the application and paying the prescribed fee is 11 December 2026.

selection_process: General Awareness, Banking and Financial Sector, Economic and Social Issues, and Computer Knowledge 15 15 15 Minutes
The SIDBI Recruitment 2026 selection process comprises three stages:
Phase I - Online screening/objective examination Phase II - English descriptive examination and stream-specific objective/descriptive examination Phase III - Interview

Phase I and Phase II will be conducted on the same day in a single sitting. Phase II papers will be evaluated only for candidates who qualify Phase I according to the minimum marks prescribed by SIDBI.
The interview component includes provision for marks relating to notable extracurricular achievements
subject to satisfactory documentary evidence. Candidates should consult the detailed notification for stream-specific syllabi
qualifying marks and other examination rules.
how_to_apply: Candidates can submit their applications exclusively through the official SIDBI website between 21 November and 11 December 2026.
Visit the SIDBI website at www.sidbi.in.
Open the Careers & Recruitment section and locate the Grade A and Grade B Officer Recruitment 2026 advertisement.
Select the official Apply Online option.
Click "Click here for New Registration" and enter the required name, contact details and email ID.
Save the provisional registration number and password generated by the system.
Complete the personal, educational, experience and other relevant details in the application form.
Upload the required photograph, signature, thumb impression and handwritten declaration according to the instructions.
Use the Preview option to verify the entered information.
After checking all details, select "Complete Registration".
Open the Payment tab and pay the prescribed fee or intimation charges using the available online payment methods.
Submit the application and save the generated e-receipt.
Download or print the completed application form for future reference.

Important: Candidates can apply for only one post. SIDBI states that where multiple applications are submitted, only the latest valid completed application will be retained, and charges paid for other registrations will be forfeited.
Changes will not be permitted after completing registration. Applicants should therefore verify their details before final submission.

content_sections.heading: SIDBI Grade A and B Vacancy 2026 - Post-wise Details
content_sections.text: SIDBI has advertised 68 Officer posts, including 63 vacancies for Assistant Manager Grade A and 5 vacancies for Manager Grade B. The Grade A recruitment covers four streams, while Grade B vacancies are available in three specialist streams. Reservations for Persons with Benchmark Disabilities (PwBD), including backlog vacancies, are separately indicated within the advertised vacancies. These are not additional posts. The vacancy numbers are provisional and may change according to SIDBI's requirements.

content_sections.heading: SIDBI Grade A and B Recruitment 2026 Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Eligibility for SIDBI Grade A and Grade B recruitment depends on the post, educational qualification, relevant experience and age limit. Candidates should not assume that a qualification accepted for one stream is automatically valid for another. The educational qualification and post-qualification experience cut-off date is 11 December 2026. The age eligibility cut-off date is 21 November 2026.

content_sections.heading: SIDBI Grade A and B Educational Qualification 2026
content_sections.text: Candidates must possess one of the following qualifications from an appropriately recognized institution: Graduation in Commerce, Economics, Mathematics, Statistics, Business Administration or Engineering with at least 60% marks in aggregate, or 50% for eligible SC/ST/PwBD candidates where vacancies are reserved for them. Company Secretary (CS), Cost and Management Accountant (CMA), Chartered Financial Analyst (CFA) or Chartered Accountant (CA). Two-year full-time MBA or PGDM in any discipline from an institution recognized or approved by the relevant authority. Applicants pursuing the final year of a qualifying MBA/PGDM programme may apply, subject to producing the required final marksheet and degree certificate at joining if selected. Candidates must meet one of the following educational qualification routes: A bachelor's degree with at least 60% marks (55% for eligible SC/ST/PwBD candidates), with Hindi and English studied as compulsory or elective subjects for at least two years, along with a postgraduate diploma of at least one year in translation between Hindi and English. A master's degree in Hindi with at least 50% marks, with English studied as a main or elective subject for at least two years during graduation. A master's degree in English with at least 50% marks, with Hindi studied as a main or elective subject for at least two years during graduation. Candidates must be able to translate from English to Hindi and vice versa. Applicants must have a bachelor's degree in Law from a recognized university or institution with at least 50% marks in aggregate, or 45% for eligible SC/ST/PwBD candidates where applicable. Candidates must also be enrolled as advocates with the Bar Council of India. A master's degree in Law, CS qualification and proficiency in computer applications are desirable. Applicants must possess a B.E./B.Tech degree in any discipline or an MCA from a recognized institution with at least 60% marks, or 55% for eligible SC/ST/PwBD candidates where the relevant reservation applies. Preference may be given to candidates with engineering degrees in Computer Science, Computer Technology, Information Technology, Electronics, Electronics and Communication Engineering or allied disciplines. Relevant certifications in AI/ML, Data Science, Full Stack Application Development, information security or IT service management are desirable. Grade B applicants must satisfy the relevant specialist-stream educational qualifications: Hindi: A qualifying bachelor's degree with Hindi and English plus a postgraduate translation diploma, or a master's degree in Hindi or English with the prescribed graduation-level language study requirements. Legal: A recognized bachelor's degree in Law with at least 50% marks (45% for eligible reserved-category candidates where applicable) and enrolment as an advocate with the Bar Council of India. content_sections.heading: SIDBI Grade A and B Recruitment 2026 Work Experience Requirements
content_sections.text: Work experience is a major eligibility condition in SIDBI Recruitment 2026. The applicable requirement depends on both the grade and stream. However, candidates must still satisfy the remaining eligibility conditions and qualify through SIDBI's selection process. For other Grade A General applicants, relevant work experience must fall within the duties and organizations specified in the official notification. Experience exclusively related to personal, education, vehicle or housing loans is not accepted under the applicable lending-experience provisions.

rows.required_experience: Two years of relevant officer-level experience, or three years of specified clerk/equivalent experience, under the permitted experience routes. An exemption applies to qualifying CA and full-time two-year MBA/PGDM holders.
At least 2 years in translation, terminology or Official Language policy-related work
At least 2 years as a Law Officer in relevant legal, recovery or commercial contract management functions
At least 2 years in relevant IT or Systems Officer functions
At least 5 years of relevant post-qualification experience
At least 5 years of relevant Law Officer experience
At least 5 years of relevant IT or Systems Officer experience, including prescribed domain-specific technical experience

content_sections.heading: SIDBI Grade A and B Recruitment 2026 Age Limit
content_sections.text: The age limits for Grade A and Grade B are calculated as on 21 November 2026. For Grade A, candidates must have been born between 21 November 1996 and 21 November 2005, both dates inclusive. For Grade B, the eligible birth-date range is 21 November 1993 to 21 November 2001, both dates inclusive, before applicable age relaxation.

content_sections.heading: SIDBI Grade A and B Salary 2026
content_sections.text: SIDBI offers different pay scales for Assistant Manager Grade A and Manager Grade B. The official notification also provides approximate monthly gross emoluments and annual cost-to-company ranges. The pay package includes applicable allowances and benefits under SIDBI rules. The actual amount may vary by place of posting and other applicable conditions. Gross emoluments and CTC should not be confused with take-home salary. Selected candidates will normally undergo probation for two years, extendable up to four years at SIDBI's discretion. Officers may be posted or transferred to SIDBI offices, verticals, associates or subsidiaries according to organizational requirements.

content_sections.heading: SIDBI Grade A and B Recruitment 2026 Application Fee
content_sections.text: The application fee and intimation charges are non-refundable and inclusive of applicable GST.

content_sections.heading: SIDBI Grade A and B Selection Process 2026
content_sections.text: The SIDBI Recruitment 2026 selection process comprises three stages: Phase I - Online screening/objective examination Phase II - English descriptive examination and stream-specific objective/descriptive examination Phase III - Interview Phase I and Phase II will be conducted on the same day in a single sitting. Phase II papers will be evaluated only for candidates who qualify Phase I according to the minimum marks prescribed by SIDBI. The interview component includes provision for marks relating to notable extracurricular achievements, subject to satisfactory documentary evidence. Candidates should consult the detailed notification for stream-specific syllabi, qualifying marks and other examination rules.

content_sections.heading: Documents Required for SIDBI Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Candidates should keep the following documents and details available while completing the application and during subsequent verification stages: Recent passport-size colour photograph Scanned signature in black ink Scanned left thumb impression Handwritten declaration in English Valid personal email ID and mobile number Educational qualification certificates and marksheets Experience certificates and relevant employment records, where applicable Valid identity and date-of-birth proof Applicable SC, ST, OBC, EWS or PwBD certificate No Objection Certificate for specified employed candidates at the interview stage The photograph, signature, thumb impression and handwritten declaration must follow the image and file specifications provided in the official notification. The online application process also includes live photograph capture. The declaration must be written in the candidate's own handwriting in English, subject to the accessibility exception specified in the notification.

content_sections.heading: SIDBI Recruitment 2026 NOC Requirements
content_sections.text: Candidates currently serving in Government, quasi-government offices, Public Sector Undertakings, nationalized banks and financial institutions are required to produce a No Objection Certificate from their employer at the interview stage. The NOC must specifically permit the candidate to appear for the SIDBI selection interview. SIDBI states that conditional NOCs will not be accepted. Failure to produce an acceptable NOC may result in the candidate not being permitted to attend the interview or continue in the selection process.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply Online for SIDBI Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Candidates can submit their applications exclusively through the official SIDBI website between 21 November and 11 December 2026. Important: Candidates can apply for only one post. SIDBI states that where multiple applications are submitted, only the latest valid completed application will be retained, and charges paid for other registrations will be forfeited. Changes will not be permitted after completing registration. Applicants should therefore verify their details before final submission.

content_sections.heading: SIDBI Recruitment 2026 Apply Online
content_sections.text: The SIDBI Recruitment 2026 online application window opens on 21 November 2026 and closes on 11 December 2026. Applications must be submitted through the official recruitment facility linked from the SIDBI website. Offline applications and printed application submissions are not accepted. faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are available in SIDBI Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: SIDBI has announced 68 vacancies, including 63 Assistant Manager Grade A posts and 5 Manager Grade B posts in General and Specialist Streams.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for SIDBI Grade A and B Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date for submitting the online application and paying the prescribed fee is 11 December 2026.

faq.question: Q3. Can freshers apply for SIDBI Grade A Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Candidates holding CA or a qualifying two-year full-time MBA/PGDM are exempt from the prescribed work-experience requirement for the Grade A General Stream. Applicants using other qualification routes and those applying for specialist posts must satisfy their respective experience requirements.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for SIDBI Grade A and B Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The age limit is 21 to 30 years for Grade A and 25 to 33 years for Grade B as on 21 November 2026. Age relaxation applies to eligible categories according to the official advertisement.

faq.question: Q5. What is the application fee for SIDBI Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The total payable amount is ₹175 for SC/ST/PwBD candidates and ₹1,100 for General, OBC, EWS and other candidates. The charges are inclusive of applicable GST.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary for SIDBI Grade A and Grade B Officers?
faq.answer: SIDBI has indicated approximate monthly gross emoluments of ₹1,20,000 for Grade A and ₹1,45,000 for Grade B. The starting basic pay is ₹62,500 and ₹78,450, respectively.

faq.question: Q7. When is the SIDBI Grade A and B Exam 2026?
faq.answer: The Phase I and Phase II online examinations are tentatively scheduled for 27 December 2026. Interviews are tentatively scheduled for February 2027.

faq.question: Q8. Can candidates apply for more than one SIDBI post?
faq.answer: No. The official notification states that a candidate can apply for only one post. If multiple applications are submitted, only the latest valid completed application will be retained, subject to the notification's conditions.

faq.question: Q9. Is an NOC required for SIDBI Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Yes, for candidates employed in the specified Government, quasi-government, PSU, nationalized bank or financial institution categories. Such candidates must produce an acceptable No Objection Certificate from their employer at the interview stage.

faq.question: Q10. What is the official website for SIDBI Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The official SIDBI website is www.sidbi.in. Applicants should use the Careers & Recruitment section for the recruitment notice and official application facility.
